overall_goal: Heat a frying pan and grease it evenly with butter

goals.description: Place the frying pan on the stove and turn on the heat
goals.rationale: The person sets the pan on the gas stove and turns on the flame to begin heating it.

goals.description: Retrieve butter and a butter knife
goals.rationale: The person fetches a pack of butter from the refrigerator and a knife from a drawer to prepare for greasing the pan.
The person opens the butter packet and uses the knife to cut off a small piece.

goals.description: Melt and spread butter on the heated pan
goals.rationale: The person places the cut butter onto the hot pan, adjusts the flame, and spreads the melting butter evenly across the surface.

goals.description: Add and spread additional butter on the pan
goals.rationale: The person cuts more butter and uses a spoon to transfer and spread the extra butter onto the frying pan.
